messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic canary alert: synth-canary-eu-west failure rate exceeded threshold. Window=10m, failures=27/200 (13.5%) > 3% threshold. Probe group: synth-canary-eu-west-v2. Check ID probe-8472. Grafana: https://graf.redwood.ai/d/abc123/canary?org=redwood
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-8721 created and routed to escalation policy 'synth-canary-oncall'; notifying Maya (primary). Link: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-8721
Maya: acked. I'm on it :white_check_mark:
Maya: quick tl;dr — probes are returning 401s from auth-gw (looks like token auth). Customer telemetry (edge/production metrics) shows no 5xx spike. Likely prober auth or secrets issue, not backend outage.
Jun: confirmed on grafana — probe 401s started right after 04:12 UTC when secrets-rotation job ran. No corresponding errors in product logs for customer traffic. :thinking_face:
Maya: running a quick curl against the probe endpoint from prober host
Maya: ```bash
# from prober runner
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer ${PROBER_TOKEN}" https://synth-probe-eu-west.redwood.ai/health
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_token",
  "detail": "token expired"
}
```
Jun: ok that matches — token used by prober expired / rotated. Was there a config rollout? Checking rotations
engops-bot: Secrets rotation job 'secrets-rotate-2026-03-15' completed at 04:11:58 UTC. Affected secret: /prober/token/synth-eu-west
Maya: looks like the rotation wrote a new secret but prober runners didn't pick it up (no restart). We need to refresh the secret in the prober process.
Caroline: what prober flavor? systemd unit or k8s daemonset?
Maya: k8s DaemonSet on cluster eu-west-probers. I'll patch the token as a k8s secret and roll the ds.
Maya: ```bash
kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/synth-prober PROBER_TOKEN="<new-token>" --record
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/synth-prober
```
Maya: restarting now — will post results
Maya: restart in progress :gear:
Jun: while that's rolling, let's suppress noisy alerts to avoid PD storms. I'll put a 15m suppression on the probe alert rule.
Jun: ```sql
# suppress rule
POST /api/alert/suppress
{"rule":"synth-canary-fail-rate","duration_min":15}
```
Maya: rollout finished on 3/3 pods in eu-west. Re-running a few probe calls:
Maya: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <new-token>" https://synth-probe-eu-west.redwood.ai/health
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"status":"ok","latency_ms":78}
```
Maya: probes are green again. Recomputed window now 2/210 failures (0.95%) < 3% threshold. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: Note: PD-8721 acknowledged and will be resolved by the on-call. Please add postmortem if any follow-up actions required.
Maya: resolving PD incident and keeping a short follow-up ticket for automation gap: PROJOPS-2231 (audit and ensure prober picks up rotated secrets automatically)
Maya: initial impact summary: no customer-facing 5xx observed, only synthetic canaries failed due to expired token not loaded by prober. Root cause: secrets-rotation wrote new token but prober daemonset did not auto-reload secrets. Mitigation: rolled prober daemonset to pick up new secret. Next steps: create hotfix to support in-place secret refresh and add healthcheck on secret age. ETA for follow-up ticket: 2 days.
Dinesh: taking ownership for the follow-up (will own PROJOPS-2231). I'll run an audit across regions to ensure same pattern not present in apac/eu-other. Handoff to morning shift: monitor for 30m and check alerts/backfill.
Maya: leaving notes in the incident doc. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-8721
Maya: marking thread resolved but keeping it open for 30m watch. :eyes:
Jun: thanks — great catch. Suggest we add a postmortem blameless note and timeline. I'll draft.
Maya: PD-8721 status -> resolved. Follow-up ticket PROJOPS-2231 created. Closing the page :white_check_mark:
engops-bot: Automated postmortem template created at https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/PROJOPS-2231
Dinesh: acknowledged, will update status tomorrow morning.
Caroline: nice work team. :clap:
